newsitem.title: UK: UK's ITV says audience share up in early 1997.
newsitem.headline: UK's ITV says audience share up in early 1997.

text.p: Britain's ITV commercial television network said on Tuesday that its audience share had improved early this year after suffering from increased competition in 1996.
ITV said that its peaktime audience share for the last two weeks had been 41.1 and 41.5 percent respectively against 40 and 39.9 percent in the same period 12 months ago.

A report released on Tuesday by the Institute of Practitioners in Advertising (IPA), a trade group, said that ITV's total audience share dropped to 35.1 percent in the last quarter of 1996, from 37.6 percent a year earlier.
The IPA said ITV was losing ground to cable and satellite channels.

ITV noted that it maintained a 40 percent share for the important peaktime periods throughout 1996 as a whole. It said that the rise of cable and satellite channels was inevitable as they became available in more homes.
"Being the brand leader, we have the perennial problem of keeping on top. But we continually do so," ITV said.
